content:
alek-support: pinging the channel — ClinicCare SOC opened an audit claim: missing audit-log entries for a 3-hour window (2024-05-02 02:00–05:00 UTC) and they need KMS/HSM rotation evidence for the BAA. Customer says exports from the console show fewer events than their internal replay.

jordan-support: ack. can you drop the ticket id and what the customer provided?

alek-support: ticket #RD-54231. they uploaded a CSV summary and a screenshot of the Console export showing ~2.1k events vs their replay which shows ~3.7k. attached notes: "missing admin:session_end" events. Customer wants full raw export (ndjson preferred) + KMS key rotation log and HSM attestation.

sam-eng-sre: assigning to eng-sre to investigate retention/export pipeline. quick questions: 1) did they use the UI export or the S3 export job? 2) which org id? 3) are they on Dedicated or Hosted?

alek-support: answers from SOC: UI export in Console; org id org_7721; hosted (BAA enabled). they pulled artifacts at 2024-05-03 13:12 UTC.

maria-security: tagging for KMS/HSM proof — we need the KMS key id and rotation history, plus HSM export proof of signing. sam, can you fetch the key metadata and rotation audit events? include CMK ARN and CloudTrail entries.

sam-eng-sre: on it. preliminary: I see export job that runs via lambda -> s3 prefix /exports/org_7721/audit/2024-05-02-02-05. listing now. if UI export truncates by default to 2k rows for preview that could explain count mismatch. but we need to confirm full S3 payload.

sam-eng-sre: found file s3://redwood-exports/exports/org_7721/audit/2024-05-02-02-05/audit-20240502-020000.ndjson.gz (size 74MB). will generate signed manifest and share.

alek-support: customer asked for verifiable chain of custody and rotation log. Maria, what artifacts do we need to produce for BAA?

maria-security: minimum: 1) full NDJSON export, gzip, with SHA256 checksums; 2) KMS CMK creation + rotation timestamps (CloudTrail events) covering last 2 years; 3) HSM signing attestation PDF (or pointer to vendor attestation) for the key material used; 4) a short statement of retention policy (where logs are kept, retention durations, purge job schedule). Also include who requested export and the export job id.

sam-eng-sre: preparing export: will create a read-only, time-limited S3 presigned URL and a signed manifest. sample commands I will run for customer deliverable:

```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-exports/exports/org_7721/audit/2024-05-02-02-05/audit-20240502-020000.ndjson.gz ./
shasum -a 256 audit-20240502-020000.ndjson.gz > audit-20240502-020000.ndjson.gz.sha256
gpg --detach-sign --armor audit-20240502-020000.ndjson.gz
```

sam-eng-sre: also grabbing CloudTrail entries for KMS events: Lookup by CMK alias: alias/redwood/org_7721_cmks.

jordan-support: FYI leaving note for customer: "We are assembling the full export plus cryptographic checksums and KMS rotation traces; security team will attach HSM attestation. ETA 4 business hours." cc @ClinicCare SOC (forwarded link to ticket).

alek-support: customer replied: they ran a replay tool that emits events with slightly different formatting — they insist some session_end events are absent in our NDJSON. asking if we filter events server-side.

sam-eng-sre: we don't filter session_end by default. we do have two layers: streaming pipeline (hot) and cold parquet archive. possible scenarios: 1) UI export hit API timeout and returned truncated preview; 2) export job failed mid-stream and retry produced partial; 3) replay tool interprets surrogate events as session_end. I'll diff counts across hot buffer and cold archive.

sam-eng-sre: quick check: hot buffer count for that window = 3,721 events; cold archive count = 3,719; UI preview returned 2,139 (timed out, truncated). looks like UI behavior. attaching debug snippet for the export API call that timed out: 

```
GET /v1/exports?org=org_7721&from=2024-05-02T02:00:00Z&to=2024-05-02T05:00:00Z
x-timeout-ms: 30000
response: 206 Partial Content (connection closed after 30s)
```

sam-eng-sre: conclusion: full S3 NDJSON contains the events needed. will provide manifest + presigned URL + sha256 + gpg signature. also pulling CloudTrail evidence for CMK rotation events.

maria-security: for HSM attestation, we have vendor-signed PDF attestation for our HSM cluster (attached to ticket RD-0001-ATT). I will redact internal hostnames and produce exportable statement: "Key material for org_7721 was generated under HSM cluster HSM-3, vendor attestation ID att-2023-11-12" — need approver from legal.

jordan-support: noted. I created escalation subtask ES-785 and linked RD-54231 -> ES-785. deadline for initial artifact bundle: today EOD.

alek-support: passing to customer: "We confirmed UI export was truncated due to timeout. We will deliver full NDJSON export + checksums + KMS rotation CloudTrail events + vendor HSM attestation by EOD. If you prefer an on-prem transfer, we can SFTP the bundle. Please confirm preferred delivery and any PII redaction requirements"

oncall-bot: incident-preserve: export snapshot created snapshot_id=sn-20240305-7721-01, retention=90d, access=limited.

sam-eng-sre: upload complete. presigned URL: https://presign.redwood.example/rd-exports/org_7721/2024-05-02/audit.tar.gz?sig=XXX (valid 72h). manifest: audit-20240502-manifest.json (includes sha256 + gpg sig). CloudTrail bundle attached as cloudtrail-kms-org_7721-rotations.json.gz.

jordan-support: sending bundle to customer now via secure link and updating ticket. customer acknowledged receipt and will validate counts tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

alek-support: closing loop here. if SOC reports missing events after validating NDJSON, escalate to eng-runtime to trace ingestion path. thanks all.
__notes: Generated synthetic Slack thread for support escalation about audit logs, KMS/HSM evidence, and retention for a healthcare BAA customer. Conforms to agents.md: single thread string, metadata fields present.
